deviations.what: the sap.m.plugins.UploadSetwithTable control (since UI5 1.124) is newer than 1.71 and is the whole point of this sample - kept 1:1 in the sap.ui.table.TreeTable's dependents as plugins:UploadSetwithTable (the original's dotted m:plugins.UploadSetwithTable), with the UploadItemConfiguration as its default rowConfiguration aggregation; the app needs a UI5 release >= 1.124. Every member it carries (uploadUrl, multiple, cloudFilePickerEnabled, the actions association, beforeUploadStarts, itemRenamed) is as new as the plugin.

the plugin's companion controls are kept 1:1 and are post-1.71 too: sap.m.upload.ActionsPlaceholder (@since 1.120, with placeholderFor - the toolbar slot the plugin renders its upload button into) and sap.m.upload.UploadItemConfiguration (@since 1.124; fileNamePath, mediaTypePath, urlPath, previewablePath and fileSizePath @1.124, isTrustedSourcePath @1.125 and isDirectoryPath @1.139 - the app needs UI5 >= 1.139), written upload:UploadItemConfiguration for the original's dotted m:upload.UploadItemConfiguration.

The named JSONModel documents (manifest dataSource model/documents.json) is folded into the default model: every {documents>x} binding is the row field {X} and the TreeTable's rows are the bound T_ITEMS - documents.json is a folder tree three levels deep, so T_ITEMS has one row type per level (every level carrying every field, the upper two their ITEMS; an empty ITEMS array is a leaf to the JSON tree binding, like the original's absent property). All nine nodes (three folders, six files) are inlined; the revision and id columns of the original are commented out of its view, so revision is not carried (id is - the Edit URL lookup uses it); the url and imageUrl fields are host-absolutized to https://sdk.openui5.org/test-resources/... because an abap2UI5 app has no demo-kit root to resolve the relative test-resources paths against. The UploadItemConfiguration paths name the upper-case ABAP fields (FILENAME, MEDIATYPE, URL, PREVIEWABLE, FILESIZE, TRUSTEDSOURCE) instead of fileName/mediaType/... - the same model columns. IMAGEURL and UPLOADSTATE are bound with omit_initial_paths, so a row the mock gives no imageUrl/uploadState still reads undefined and the original's own Image/Icon visible expressions and the RowSettings highlight expression decide exactly as in the sample.

The controller formatters getIconSrc (sap-icon://folder-full for a directory, else UploadSetwithTable.getIconForFileType - IconPool's media-type table, the file-extension fallback with sap-icon://card for images) and getFileSizeWithUnits (KB/MB/GB with two decimals; a folder has no fileSize, so its cell stays empty) run in ABAP (icon_for, size_with_units) and the row carries the finished values in two port fields, ICON and FILESIZE_UNITS, which core:Icon.src and the File Size Text bind - the thin-frontend rule; the {parts: [...], formatter: ...} bindings are gone with them.

Upload: the sample starts a sinon fake XHR server (model/mockserver.js) in beforeUploadStarts, which answers the POST to /uploadFiles with 201 and unshifts the new document. There is no such endpoint behind an abap2UI5 app, so the port plays the mock server's part in the backend: beforeUploadStarts is a backend wire with check_prevent_default (the plugin's own veto - no XHR is sent) that transports the item's file name, media type and size, and the backend unshifts the row the mock server would have created (uploadState Complete, revision 00, In work, Jane Burns, Invoice, trustedSource) and shows the 'Document Added' toast at once rather than after the sample's one-second setTimeout. Lost with it: the uploaded file's blob: object URL (an uploaded row has an empty url, so it cannot be previewed or downloaded) and the random uid id (a running number); uploadCompleted and onActivated are not wired (no upload completes, and the plugin is addressed by an added id uploadSetPlugin instead of the instance onActivated handed the controller); URLListValidator.add('blob') is dropped. Several files picked at once fire beforeUploadStarts back to back and abap2UI5 runs one round-trip at a time: check_queue_last keeps the last one, so only the first and the last of them are added.

onDownloadFiles maps the TreeTable's getSelectedIndices( ) to contexts and calls the plugin's download( context, true ) for EVERY selected row; a UI5 event expression has no loop, so the port's Download button calls download for the first selected row only, through a view-wired control_by_id on the plugin whose argument is $controller.getView().byId('table-uploadSet').getContextByIndex(...getSelectedIndices()[0]).

Unverified in a running system: (a) the plugin calls by id (uploadSetPlugin, an id the original does not carry) through the unlisted-method path of control_by_id - openFilePreview with the template Link's $event.oSource.getBindingContext(), renameItem and download with $controller.getView().byId('table-uploadSet').getContextByIndex($controller.getView().byId('table-uploadSet').getSelectedIndices()[0]) - each handing the live Context object through castArgAuto untouched; (b) rowSelectionChange transporting $event.oSource.getBinding('rows').getSelectedContexts().join() (Context.toString is the binding path, e.g. /T_ITEMS/0/ITEMS/1) and the itemRenamed wire reading ${$parameters>/item}.getBindingContext().getPath(); (c) the vetoed beforeUploadStarts and ${$parameters>/item}.getFileObject().size. **e2e-verified 2026-10-20** (nightly e2e interaction, meta/interactions/z2ui5_cl_smpc_app_660.mjs).

onSelectionChange reads the rows binding's selected contexts and tells files from folders: Download is enabled for one or more selected files, Remove/Rename/Edit URL for exactly one file, and both stay disabled as soon as a folder is selected - two bound flags, decided in the backend from the selected rows' binding paths. onDocumentRenamedSuccess writes the new name into the renamed node at whatever depth it sits (the itemRenamed wire carries its path and the item's file name) and toasts 'Document Renamed.' with duration 2000. The controller's quirks are kept: removeItem splices index split('/')[2] of the row's path out of /items - for a file inside a folder that is its TOP-LEVEL folder, which is removed with everything in it - and its removeSelections( ) does not exist on sap.ui.table.TreeTable, so the selection stays; the Edit URL Save looks the selected row up by id in the top-level /items only, so for a file inside a folder the original's Object.assign throws and nothing is saved - the port saves nothing either, without the error.

The AddViaUrl fragment is the port's popup with its ids kept (addViaUrlDialog, addViaUrlSimpleform, urlInputLabel, urlInput, nameInputLabel, nameInput, addDocumentBtn), and what openAddOrEditDialog / _isValidName / _validateAddOrEditUrlDialog set through Element.getElementById is bound instead: the Dialog title (Add URL / Edit URL), the begin button text (Add / Apply), urlInputLabel.required, both Input values and their valueState / valueStateText. Cancel closes it with popup_close. Add validates name and URL in the backend (the unanchored URL regex reduced to its required part, a ftp/http/https scheme followed by a non-blank) and then adds the row directly - uploadItemViaUrl takes a JS Promise and the controller adds a documentUrl header field to the item, neither transportable, and the mock server's answer is exactly that row (the URL as typed, an empty media type and size 0). showEditConfirmation's controller-built sap.m.Dialog (type Message, state Warning, title Warning, Save / DiscardChanges) is a MessageBox.warning with the same title, text, actions and Save emphasized; Save updates the selected row's fileName and url and closes the fragment, DiscardChanges only closes the box. removeItem's MessageBox.warning keeps its text, actions Remove/CANCEL, emphasizedAction, styleClass and initialFocus; its explicit icon option is the warning box's own icon anyway.
